candidate_models.citation: Connarn et al. Clin Pharmacol Drug Dev. 2018;7(5):465–473
candidate_models.summary: One-compartment population model; creatinine clearance and weight covariates. Study participants had creatinine clearance above 50 mL/min.
candidate_models.selection_note: Provisional simple-structure candidate; full equations, parameter definitions and applicability remain unverified.

candidate_models.citation: Kim et al. Drug Des Devel Ther. 2026;20:605741
candidate_models.summary: Two-compartment total/unbound model in 30 myeloma patients; indexed eGFR and body surface area covariates.
candidate_models.selection_note: Alternative for review; requires additional binding/compartment definitions and full model extraction.

label_context.note: Label context supports checking renal-function definitions. This dated record is not a verified latest label or an executable covariate equation.

global_blockers.message: Select one complete model; do not combine coefficients from different publications.
Extract full structural and covariate equations, parameter tables, units and reference values.
Document population, covariate estimation methods, dose/route conditions and supported boundaries.
Define required state inputs and separate treatment inputs. Do not infer missing values or renal-measure equivalence.
Implement dimensional checks, numerical checks and reproduction of published reference results.
Define a typical prediction and its limitations before adding variability or intervals.

invariants: No patient-specific parameters or concentrations are calculated by this review.
A known value is an input-presence fact, not model eligibility.
Indexed eGFR is not creatinine clearance; which measure is appropriate depends on the selected model.
No renal-function derivation, body-surface-area calculation or unit conversion occurs.
Scenario drug, dose and medications are captured from the original saved scenario, not reinterpreted as a validated treatment schedule.
The historical teaching model remains separate and ignores patient state.
Source citations and review metadata do not authenticate uploaded patient inputs or establish model validation.
